messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — post-customer call we need to decide final cuts for the launch next month. Can we lock an MVP scope today?
kevin (ENG): I pulled the perf numbers — keeping streaming + verbose logs pushes latency past our SLO for the target instance size.
olga (Design): UX note: removing streaming changes the product feel but we could surface a loading skeleton and a polite status message as a stopgap.
alex (ML): Quantization path still has a couple of regressions on safety checks. Shipping quantized v1 as default will need another ~2w of validation.
sam (Prod-Ops): If we cut streaming we can hit the current capacity target without extra infra. Otherwise we'd need a short runway to scale autoscaler rules.
maria (PM): Proposal: make a hard MVP must-have list and a 'v1 add' list. Must-haves: text generation endpoint, basic chat UI, auth, logs/alerts. Streaming and advanced routing -> v1. Thoughts?
kevin (ENG): That seems reasonable. Quick numbers: dropping streaming reduces 95th latency by ~120ms and removes ~30% additional CPU pressure. ETA to keep streaming: +3w (engineering + infra ramp).
julia (Sales): Heads-up — ACME pilot asked specifically about streaming playback for demo. If we postpone streaming, we need a clear comms plan and a timeline for pilot.
maria (PM): Acknowledged. We can offer ACME a short demo environment with recorded streaming behavior (non-prod) and promise prioritized slot for v1. Julia — can you take that outbound?
julia (Sales): Yep, I'll own the ask and surface the concession in the pilot agreement.
olga (Design): For launch, I can deliver the skeleton state and transition copy today. That keeps UX coherent without the full streaming experience.
alex (ML): Also recommend we ship quantized model as an optional flag in v1 rather than default in MVP. Reduces risk on quality regressions.
sam (Prod-Ops): Action items: 1) Lock MVP list, 2) adjust autoscaler templates to omit streaming burst config, 3) create rollout plan for v1 streaming/cached KV. I can start 2 and 3 once MVP is locked.
maria (PM): I'll circulate an explicit `must-have` vs `nice-to-have` doc in ~30m. Quick binning now: Must = generation endpoint, basic chat UI, auth, monitoring, baseline tests. Nice-to-have = streaming, embeddings re-ranking, advanced routing.
kevin (ENG): Confirmed. We'll drop streaming from MVP. Engineering will scope remaining work into the sprint and post estimates by EOD.
alex (ML): I'll schedule extra eval runs on the unquantized path and flag any diffs in the QA dashboard.
julia (Sales): I'll update ACME and ask for leniency on the demo.
sam (Prod-Ops): Noted — I'll also prepare a rollout playbook for rapid enable of streaming when ready.
ci-bot: CI run started for `mvp/scope-lock` branch — build 4821.
maria (PM): Thanks team. If anyone sees major blockers to the cuts above, flag them in this thread now. Otherwise I'll send the consolidated scope doc in 30m. :thumbsup:
